volume_method: Exact Green cross-section area preserved by each rotated transverse section. Helical/Herringbone V=A*width. DoubleHelical V=A*(width-gap)+pi*(root_radius²-bore_radius²)*gap. Add only external hub annulus; core is already counted in A.
limits: Floating-point analytic oracle, no native geometry or numerical approximation certification.

Source matched intent uses exact basic-rack projected undercut condition, not virtual-tooth approximation. Historical no-helix-credit values retained separately; actual generating hob radius/profile is not certified.
Custom circular roots differ from rack-cutter trochoids. Conservative line-of-action/fillet checks and transverse contact>1 are required independently of helical overlap.
Both primary hands are represented with opposite member hand, and existing mirrored/gapped band phase conventions are preserved.
Hub inputs must additionally satisfy actual canonical rootclearance/wall/overlap and native solid/provenance/export guards.
